title: galactites tomentosus var. elegans
intro: Galactites tomentosus var. elegans, commonly known as Marsh Cistus or Rock Rose, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Galactites tomentosus var. elegans include its ability to promote wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
